title: Full Stack Software Engineer (Front-end focus) (m/f/d) | Berlin, Hybrid
description:
Airteam is a fast-growing Berlin SaaS startup with an AI-powered cloud platform for roofers and solar planners. Our customers turn simple drone data into actionable 3D models and measurement reports. As a Full Stack Software Engineer with a front-end focus, you'll build the web applications that take projects from drone data acquisition to customer delivery, and help create a digital, climate-neutral product.

Tasks

  • Build web applications that manage projects from drone data acquisition to customer delivery
  • Work with UI/UX and PMs to ensure technical feasibility of designs and clear, actionable tickets
  • Design and implement frontend and backend, integrate both, test and debug
  • Maintain and improve our CI/CD pipeline and container-based architecture
  • Write automated tests and technical documentation
  • Find and fix bugs and performance bottlenecks
  • Build reusable code and libraries

Requirements

  • Proficient in JavaScript (ES6/7), HTML5, CSS3
  • Experience building SPAs with Vue.js
  • Experience with Python and Flask or FastAPI
  • Knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL) and REST API design
  • Experience with Docker
  • Understanding of unit and functional testing (TDD)
  • Comfortable in an agile, product-focused team, with a drive for software craftsmanship and quick learning
  • Fluent English (written and spoken), as our team works internationally (German is a plus, but not required)

Nice-to-have

  • TypeScript
  • Django and Django Rest Framework
  • MongoDB
  • Kubernetes
  • GCP
  • Distributed systems and microservices

Benefits

  • Hybrid work, workations, and remote work by contract
  • Modern working space in the heart of Berlin
  • 30% contribution towards your pension savings
  • Regular team events and workshops

title: Team Lead AI Engineering (f/m/d)
description:
We're digitizing the construction industry – are you in?

At VESTIGAS, you build the digital backbone of the construction supply chain. We turn purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices into a digital, legally compliant platform used in everyday operations by construction companies and suppliers. You’ll work on a product with real market traction in the DACH mid-market, ship iteratively, and take ownership of solutions that must work in the field—not just in theory.


Your Role

As Team Lead – AI Engineering, you'll own the AI infrastructure and capabilities that power our supply chain platform end to end – from pipeline design to production deployment. You bring prior leadership experience and are ready to lead a team of AI engineers: setting technical direction, growing your team's capabilities, and making sure the team consistently delivers reliable, scalable AI systems.

The Technical ChallengeYour team will tackle problems like extracting structured data reliably from many different documents, building uncertainty estimation so the system knows when to flag a document for human review instead of silently guessing, and automatically reconciling purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices against each other – all within legal and compliance requirements that leave no room for "close enough." This is a domain where clean benchmark metrics mean far less than robustness against real documents nobody has seen before – and you'll set the technical direction for how the team navigates that trade-off, deciding where to push automation further and where human review still matters.
